name: Rob Flaherty
role: White House Director of Digital Strategy (2021-22)
action_per_record: Pressed platforms on specific content and policies. Feb 6, 2021 email re granddaughter parody account ("Cannot stress the degree..."); Jul 15, 2021 email to Facebook ("Are you guys fucking serious? I want an answer on what happened here and I want it today").
finding_status: Preliminary findings; 5th Cir. found White House likely coerced/significantly encouraged; vacated on standing; SCOTUS fn.4 called many district findings "clearly erroneous." Not a final merits finding.

name: Andy Slavitt
role: White House Senior Advisor, COVID response (2021)
action_per_record: Copied on Meta emails May-July 2021 about "expanded penalties" for COVID content; party to White House pressure described in the record.

name: Jen Psaki
action_per_record: Jul 15, 2021: "We're flagging problematic posts for Facebook that spread disinformation." Jul 16: "we're in regular touch with social media platforms ... You all make decisions, just like the social media platforms make decisions."

name: Vivek Murthy
action_per_record: Jul 15, 2021 advisory urging platforms to "Prioritize early detection of misinformation 'super-spreaders' and repeat offenders. Impose clear consequences for accounts that repeatedly violate platform policies." Surgeon General's office likely coerced/significantly encouraged per 5th Cir. (vacated). Bound by 2026 consent decree.
finding_status: Advisory documented; coercion finding preliminary and vacated.

name: Joe Biden
action_per_record: Jul 16, 2021: "They're killing people." Jul 19: "Facebook isn't killing people; these 12 people ... It's killing people." Oct 22, 2020 debate cited 51-official letter.

name: Kate Bedingfield
action_per_record: Jul 20, 2021 raised platforms' Section 230 liability.

name: Carol Crawford
action_per_record: Set up "COVID BOLO" meetings with platforms starting May 2021; enjoined by name in July 2023 injunction (vacated).
finding_status: CDC found likely to have "significantly encouraged" (5th Cir.); vacated.

name: Elvis Chan
role: FBI San Francisco, Assistant Special Agent in Charge
action_per_record: Hosted FBI-platform meetings; raised hack-and-leak concerns; denies urging policy changes but admits asking whether platforms changed hacked-materials policies.
finding_status: District court found FBI "significant encouragement" (p.107); FBI denies mentioning Hunter Biden. Roth testified government did not raise Hunter Biden.

name: Laura Dehmlow
role: FBI Foreign Influence Task Force section chief
action_per_record: Declined to comment when Facebook asked about the laptop after Oct 14, 2020.

name: Brian Scully
action_per_record: Described "switchboarding" — forwarding election officials' flags to platforms, which decided under their own policies; stopped in 2022.
finding_status: 5th Cir. (Oct 3) found CISA likely significantly encouraged; vacated.

name: Jen Easterly
action_per_record: Enjoined by name (2023, vacated). Quoted by House majority report on "cognitive infrastructure."
finding_status: Report characterizations are the committee majority's.

name: Francis Collins
action_per_record: Oct 8, 2020 email calling for "a quick and devastating published take down" of GBD premises.
finding_status: Documented. Email seeks a published rebuttal, not platform removal.

name: Anthony Fauci
action_per_record: Recipient of Collins email; per district record "does not specifically recall" communicating with platforms. 5th Cir. found NIAID not liable.

name: Mark Zuckerberg
action_per_record: Aug 26, 2024 letter: officials "repeatedly pressured our teams for months to censor certain COVID-19 content, including humor and satire"; "it was our decision"; regrets demoting NY Post story after general FBI warning. Jan 2025 Rogan: officials would "scream at them and curse."
finding_status: Own statements. Rogan claims of "threatening repercussions" not tied to a specific document.

name: Nick Clegg
action_per_record: Asked staff (Jul 14, 2021) why man-made claims were removed; staff replied "under pressure from the administration and others."

name: Joel Kaplan
action_per_record: Jan 7, 2025 announcement ending third-party fact-checking.

name: Yoel Roth
action_per_record: Testified Twitter "made a mistake" on NY Post; government did not raise Hunter Biden in meetings "to the best of my recollection"; asked to add "stopthesteal"/"kraken" to deamplification lists (TF#4).

name: Vijaya Gadde
action_per_record: Testified "Twitter made a mistake" on NY Post and reversed within 24 hours.

name: Jim Baker
role: Twitter Deputy General Counsel (former FBI GC)
action_per_record: Witness at Feb 8, 2023 hearing.

name: Anika Collier Navaroli
action_per_record: Testified the Trump White House asked Twitter to remove a Chrissy Teigen tweet.

name: Matt Taibbi
action_per_record: Published TF #1, 3, 6, 9, 11, 14-17, 19; testified Mar 9, 2023; wrote "there's no evidence - that I've seen - of any government involvement in the laptop story."
finding_status: Journalist; internal screenshots are the primary material.

name: Michael Shellenberger
action_per_record: Published TF #4, #7; testified Mar 9, 2023.

name: Bari Weiss
action_per_record: TF #2 (Bhattacharya on "Trends Blacklist"), #5 (staff doubted incitement).
finding_status: Journalist; blacklist was Twitter's internal action, no government request shown in that thread.

name: David Zweig
action_per_record: TF #10: "both the Trump and Biden administrations directly pressed Twitter executives"; Kulldorff tweet labeled "Misleading."

name: Lee Fang
action_per_record: TF #8: Twitter approved/protected U.S. military influence-operation accounts.

name: Jay Bhattacharya
action_per_record: Placed on Twitter "Trends Blacklist" (TF#2); alleged removals incl. YouTube roundtable. Confirmed NIH Director Mar 25, 2025, 53-47; withdrew from case on joining government (per NCLA).
source_type: Congressional record; Twitter Files; court record

name: Martin Kulldorff
action_per_record: Tweet labeled "Misleading" by Twitter (TF#10); alleged LinkedIn/YouTube actions. ACIP chair 2025; HHS ASPE chief science officer Dec 1, 2025.

name: Aaron Kheriaty
action_per_record: Alleged shadow-banning and removals (Doughty p.6). Party to 2026 settlement. UC Irvine dismissal over vaccine mandate: reported, not confirmed by primary record here.

name: Jill Hines
action_per_record: SCOTUS: made "the best showing" of standing but Facebook targeted her before most White House/CDC contacts.

name: Terry Doughty
action_per_record: Jul 4, 2023 PI ruling ("most massive attack against free speech in United States' history" — conditioned on "If the allegations ... are true"); Mar 25, 2026 consent decree.

name: Amy Coney Barrett
action_per_record: Majority opinion: no standing; "lack jurisdiction to reach the merits."

name: Samuel Alito
action_per_record: Dissent (with Thomas, Gorsuch): "blatantly unconstitutional ... If a coercive campaign is carried out with enough sophistication, it may get by."

name: William Shubb
action_per_record: Enjoined AB 2098 as to plaintiffs on vagueness grounds (Jan 25, 2023).

name: Renée DiResta / Elena Cryst
action_per_record: VP report: OSG and CDC ties; platforms acted on tickets under their own policies.

name: Alex Stamos
action_per_record: Quoted in TF#19/hearing describing EIP as filling gaps government "couldn't do" (video via third party).
finding_status: Characterization via witness; underlying video not verified here.

name: Jim Jordan
action_per_record: Recipient of Zuckerberg and Alphabet letters; majority reports issued under his committee.

name: Jamie Raskin
action_per_record: Oct 30, 2025 letter: "not a single one of Alphabet's employees testified about any coercion."

name: Elon Musk
action_per_record: Made internal documents available to Twitter Files journalists; reinstated Trump (Nov 2022).

name: Donald Trump
action_per_record: Nov 5, 2020 remarks cut away by networks (reported). Suspended by Twitter, Facebook, YouTube Jan 2021. Signed EO 14149. Trump White House also sent removal requests to Twitter (TF#1, Navaroli).
